notes.hook: 'Thailand is calling: 3 nights Pattaya, 1 night Bangkok from just ₹52,999 per person, only 10 seats, WhatsApp now'
notes.what_goes_wrong: The whole 12-second reel is a spoken price list with 'only 10 seats' and a WhatsApp ask: a price in the first line doesn't help when the reel is only an ad.
notes.reusable_pattern: Avoid: price-list ads ('from ₹52,999, only 10 seats, WhatsApp now'); put the price inside a story or a comparison.
